legal_review_triggers: Artist is under 18 or lacks full legal capacity.
Any transfer or assignment of copyright, masters or neighbouring rights is selected.
Joint ownership of masters or compositions is selected.
Personal repayment of an advance is selected.
Exclusive term exceeds three years or contains multiple automatic renewals.
The Label or Manager can sign contracts, borrow, settle claims or control the Artist's bank/payout accounts.
A CMO mandate or prior exclusive agreement may conflict with the selected rights.
A party is outside Trinidad and Tobago, or foreign tax/withholding is material.
The Artist Management Agreement is combined with label, publishing or distribution services from the same entity.

fields.help_text: Court proceedings after mediation are the lower-complexity default. Arbitration can be selected after considering cost and procedure.

options.courts_after_mediation: If mediation does not resolve the dispute within thirty days after the mediator's appointment, each party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of competent jurisdiction in the Republic of Trinidad and Tobago.
options.arbitration_after_mediation: If mediation does not resolve the dispute within thirty days after the mediator's appointment, the dispute shall be finally resolved by arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 2023 by one arbitrator agreed by the parties or appointed in accordance with that Act. The seat is Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago, the language is English, and either party may seek urgent interim relief from a court of competent jurisdiction.
